caption:
Macy's postpones Thanksgiving Day Parade for first time in its history

The retailer confirmed Wednesday that an impending nor'easter will keep the giant balloons grounded. The parade was expected to celebrate its 100th year with a record 100 inflatables.

Reported by Axios; The New York Times.

Send this to whoever on your team covers Macy's.

headlines: Macy's postpones Thanksgiving Day Parade for first time in its history
dek: An impending nor'easter will keep the giant balloons from flying; the 100th parade was to feature a record 100 inflatables.
body: The retailer confirmed the postponement on Wednesday. Macy's said the safety of participants and spectators is its top priority.
